```{r, include=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(forcats)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
source("utils/helpers.R")
```

## Introduction

This file contains the output for data checks done on harmonized phenotype data. Data importing and stacking happens in `import_data.R`.

## Data checks


```{r}
url.json <- "https://github.com/UW-GAC/primed_data_models/raw/refs/heads/main/PRIMED_phenotype_data_model.json"

df.json <- fromJSON(url.json) 

df.data_type <- df.json$tables %>% 
  mutate(
    columns = purrr::map(
      columns,
      ~ dplyr::select(.x, column, data_type)
    )
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols=columns)
```

### Blood pressure

```{r prep data}
df.blood_pressure <- read.csv("data/out/stacked_tables/cmqt_blood_pressure.csv")

df.blood_pressure.data_type <- df.data_type %>% 
  filter(table == "cmqt_blood_pressure")

vars.float <- df.blood_pressure.data_type %>% 
  filter(data_type == "float") %>% 
  pull(column)

vars.enumeration <- df.blood_pressure.data_type %>%
  filter(data_type == "enumeration") %>%
  pull(column)
```

#### Float variables

```{r float plots}
display_float_plots(
  vars.float=vars.float,
  df=df.blood_pressure
)
```

Note that one dataset (PRIMED_CHS_DBGAP_PHS000287_V7_P1_DS-CVD-MDS_42905ed075a4b6ea.tsv) has only one data point, so it was not displayed in these plots.

#### Enumeration variables

```{r enumeration plots}
display_enumeration_plots(
  vars.enumeration=vars.enumeration,
  df=df.blood_pressure
)
```

#### Missingness check

```{r}
display_missingness(
  vars.enumeration=vars.enumeration,
  vars.float=vars.float,
  df=df.blood_pressure
)
```

#### Domain-specific checks

To be implemented in next iteration.
